mapper.select: SELECT umf.maintenance_fee_seq , umf.next_payment_installment , umf.note , umf.app_seq , vtdp."maintFeeDeadline" , vtdp."maintFeePenaltyDeadline" , vtdp."maintFeeOrderDate" , vtdp."maintFeePaymentDate" FROM utb_maintenance_fee umf LEFT JOIN v_total_duedate_pivot vtdp ON umf.maintenance_fee_seq = vtdp.tbl_seq WHERE umf.maintenance_fee_seq = #{maintenanceFeeSeq} AND umf.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND umf.app_seq = #{appSeq} AND umf.del_yn = 'N'
